messages:
jamie: Postmortem follow-up: LB/DNS retry surge yesterday during cross-region deployment. Need owners/timelines for fixes and monitoring.

jamie: Short root cause: stale SNI->route cache + permissive fallback logic in LB combined with transient egress RSTs. Result: retries amplified and traffic shift.

jamie: Open items:
- short-term: force cache flush + reduce SNI TTLs
- mid-term: make fallback explicit (opt-in) and add reconcile hook
- test: reproducible harness for cert-rotate + egress-reset
- observability: retry-storm alert with region/SNI tags

jamie: Assigning owners 1 please ack with ETA.

tess: I can own the TTL + cache flush work. Plan: add admin endpoint to force refresh and set impacted TTL 30s->8s. ETA: tomorrow noon. Will add unit test for stale-kv behavior.

omar: I'll take the LB config change to make fallback explicit. Need infra review for schema change. Target PR by Fri. Will default to opt-in to be safe.

ravi: I'll add the chaos harness and a perf-ci job that simulates cross-region cert rotate + egress RSTs. ETA: Thu afternoon.

alerts-bot: Incident REM-2026-077 created. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/REM-2026-077. Reminder: @tess in 1 day.

jamie: Deployment plan: canary at 5% for 30m, requires synthetic probe passing <0.5% retry rate before widening. Auto-rollback on probe failure.

tess: Pushed branch `git@repo:redwood/infra#sni-fast-refresh`. Will open PR once tests pass.

omar: Will add `fallback_policy` enum (allow|reject|log) and migration notes. Starting with `allow` default and opt-in `reject`.

ravi: Harness job named `ci/net-retry-race`. Will include healthcheck to fail canary if retry spikes.

alerts-bot: Scheduled weekly follow-ups Tue 09:00 for owners until REM-2026-077 is resolved.

jamie: Decision log: TTL targeted change + opt-in fallback. Action recap: tess (TTL+refresh, ETA: tomorrow noon), omar (LB schema PR, ETA: Fri), ravi (harness, ETA: Thu). Update the postmortem with PR links and set items to In Progress when started.

tess: Ack.

omar: Ack.

ravi: Ack.

jamie: Also propose a monthly "networking incidents" retro to track recurrence. Who wants to co-chair?
or: I'll co-chair with @jamie.

jamie: Thanks. I'll add calendar invite. Will follow up in 24h with rollup. :thumbsup:
